content.value: . The grade on a class test were 0, 1, 2... 10. The main grade was 5.4 and the standard deviation was 1.5. Assume that the grade is normally distributed. Determine,
(i) the probability of students scoring 6, and (ii) the maximum grade of the lowest 20% of the class. Hence, find the estimated number of students scoring 6 among 30 students.
